label: Same-end mover selection from unrestricted inheritance (inference)
rule: Choose a given distinct actual mover and instantiate unrestricted same-end inheritance
meaning: Sole-premise weakening of the existing every-distinct-mover policy to existence of one direction-preserving distinct actual mover, restricted to natural-body targets. Same MovesIn and Directs dictionaries and exact x/e throughout. This checks a strength relation, not premise warrant; no strictness or minimality claim and no new countermodel. The old direct primitive input remains available.
